rounds.response: Don’t commit—we’re looking at ~2 mid/left plus a sniffing flank on right and A is only ~75%, so it’s too risky to force. Immediate: B hold mid box, A stay on our mid angle and avoid deep peeks, C anchor the flag and track/announce that right dot; everyone ping counts/cooldowns now. If the right dot tucks back and A sees ≤1 on left, on my call A will do a 2–3s full entry left; if A calls “clear” B commits within 2s and C rotates to secure, but if A meets 2+ or is focused abort and reset. If the probe is inconclusive, reset for 6–8s to regen and repeat—don’t call “free” without direct vision.
